description: Single source of truth for the model feature contract (PRED-8). Consumed by data-pipeline/src/train_compare.py at training time and by ai-service/app/main.py at serving time. Any change requires a version bump and retraining. Numeric 'range' bounds are serving-time sanity checks (KAN-103 extension of PRED-8): generous limits that catch unit mistakes and nonsense inputs; they are metadata and do not change the contract version.
target_classification: is_late (bool) — actual finish later than planned finish
target_regression: delay_days (float) — actual minus planned finish, calendar days
